value.upperNote: If the Sangiin (Councillors) rejects or amends a bill, the Shūgiin (Representatives) can override with a two-thirds majority.

dissolution.body: The PM may dissolve the Shūgiin and call an election; bills in progress lapse.

quirks.title: Shūgiin override
quirks.body: The lower house can override the Sangiin with a two-thirds vote.

quirks.title: Cabinet bills
quirks.body: Most legislation is Cabinet-submitted (Kakuhō), not member-introduced.

quirks.title: Dissolution
quirks.body: The PM can dissolve the Shūgiin, ending all pending business.

chief_cabinet_secretary.name: Government Transparency Initiative
chief_cabinet_secretary.description: Launch a whole-of-government transparency push to improve trust and message discipline.

chief_cabinet_secretary.name: Press Briefing Blitz
chief_cabinet_secretary.description: Run a dense cycle of briefings and disclosures to improve press-freedom sentiment and confidence in government communication.

finance_minister.name: Fiscal Stimulus Package
finance_minister.description: Deploy a targeted fiscal package to support demand and employment nationwide.

finance_minister.name: Employment Subsidy Program
finance_minister.description: Fund an emergency employment subsidy for small and medium-sized firms to keep workers attached to the labor market.

foreign_affairs_minister.name: International Trade Summit
foreign_affairs_minister.description: Host a major trade summit to strengthen market access and foreign confidence in Japan's economy.

foreign_affairs_minister.name: Diplomatic Exchange Program
foreign_affairs_minister.description: Launch a cultural and diplomatic exchange to improve international goodwill and domestic confidence in the government's diplomacy.

justice_minister.name: Anti-Corruption Raids
justice_minister.description: Deploy national investigators to pursue corruption networks and signal clean governance.

justice_minister.name: Court Backlog Clearance
justice_minister.description: Temporary staffing and case-management support to speed justice delivery and reduce crime spillovers.

defense_minister.name: National Disaster Readiness Drill
defense_minister.description: Coordinate a large-scale civil-defense and disaster-readiness exercise with the Self-Defense Forces.

defense_minister.name: Defense White Paper Rollout
defense_minister.description: Publish and communicate a major readiness review to improve public confidence in national preparedness.

economy_minister.name: National Startup Accelerator
economy_minister.description: Launch a government-backed accelerator network to boost entrepreneurship and commercialization.

economy_minister.name: Robotics Investment Initiative
economy_minister.description: Direct capital and procurement support into industrial robotics and automation.

health_minister.name: Elder Care Expansion
health_minister.description: Fund a temporary expansion of elder care capacity and staffing across the country.

health_minister.name: Work Reform Campaign
health_minister.description: Run an enforcement and public-education campaign against overwork culture and labor violations.

education_minister.name: Education Excellence Initiative
education_minister.description: Deploy additional support for classroom quality and teacher development to improve student outcomes.

education_minister.name: National Skills Training Program
education_minister.description: Partner with industry and schools on an intensive upskilling and technical training push.

land_minister.name: Shinkansen Expansion Push
land_minister.description: Accelerate planning and funding approvals for high-speed rail and regional transport upgrades.

land_minister.name: Resilience Upgrade Program
land_minister.description: Fast-track evacuation routes, seawalls, and infrastructure hardening to improve disaster preparedness.

environment_minister.name: Clean Energy Acceleration
environment_minister.description: Fast-track renewable approvals and support packages to shift the energy mix faster.

environment_minister.name: Air Quality Intervention
environment_minister.description: Deploy targeted monitoring and emissions controls in polluted urban corridors.

internal_affairs_minister.name: Digital Japan Initiative
internal_affairs_minister.description: Accelerate broadband and digital service deployment for households and local governments.

internal_affairs_minister.name: Regional Revitalization Program
internal_affairs_minister.description: Deploy incentives and local-government support to stabilize declining regions and attract families and workers.

tierSetting.name: Fiscal Stance
tierSetting.description: Set the cabinet's fiscal stance. Stimulus boosts growth and hiring but adds cost pressure; consolidation cools inflation pressure at the expense of growth.

options.label: Consolidation
options.description: Prioritize fiscal restraint. Eases cost pressure but slows growth and hiring momentum.

options.label: Balanced
options.description: Maintain a neutral fiscal stance.

options.label: Stimulus
options.description: Accelerate spending and support demand. Growth and jobs improve faster, but prices run a bit hotter.

regionalTarget.name: Regional Industrial Relief
regionalTarget.description: Direct fiscal support to one region facing weaker growth. The target region gets faster growth and labor-market support.

emergency.name: Emergency Stabilization Package
emergency.description: Deploy a temporary stabilization package for a region under acute economic stress, sharply lifting growth and employment for one turn window.

bondProfile.name: Sovereign Bond Maturity Profile
bondProfile.description: Set the split of quarterly sovereign debt issuance across 1-year, 2-year, and 5-year maturities.

tierSetting.name: Sentencing Guidance
tierSetting.description: Set the national sentencing stance. Stricter sentencing deters crime more quickly but raises justice-system intensity; leniency reduces that pressure at the cost of weaker deterrence.

options.label: Lenient
options.description: Reduce sentencing severity and emphasize rehabilitation.

options.label: Standard
options.description: Maintain current sentencing guidance.

options.label: Strict
options.description: Tighten sentencing guidance to deter crime more aggressively.

regionalTarget.name: Anti-Corruption Taskforce
regionalTarget.description: Concentrate justice ministry investigators in one region to root out corruption and organized crime.

emergency.name: Emergency Prosecutorial Surge
emergency.description: Deploy prosecutors and court support into a high-crime region for a temporary enforcement surge.

tierSetting.name: Civil Defense Readiness
tierSetting.description: Choose the national defense readiness level. Higher readiness improves confidence and disaster coordination but raises public tension slightly.

options.label: Reduced
options.description: Lower readiness across the force, reducing upkeep. Civil-defence coverage thins with it.

options.label: Standard
options.description: Maintain normal readiness.

options.label: Elevated
options.description: Raise the readiness every formation trains toward, strengthening civil-defence resilience at higher upkeep and some public tension.

regionalTarget.name: Regional Readiness Focus
regionalTarget.description: Concentrate training and civil-defense logistics in one region to improve preparedness and public confidence.

tierSetting.name: Industrial Strategy
tierSetting.description: Choose whether METI prioritizes incumbents, balanced modernization, or startup-led disruption.

options.label: Incumbent Support
options.description: Back large exporters and industrial champions.

options.label: Balanced
options.description: Maintain a mixed industrial strategy.

options.label: Startup Push
options.description: Favor entrepreneurship and commercialization.

regionalTarget.name: Industrial Cluster Priority
regionalTarget.description: Designate one region as an innovation and advanced manufacturing cluster.

emergency.name: SME Liquidity Facility
emergency.description: Deploy emergency financing to a region's small businesses during a downturn.

health_minister.department: Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare

tierSetting.name: Care Delivery Focus
tierSetting.description: Set whether the ministry emphasizes hospital throughput, elder care, or labor reform balance.

options.label: Hospital Focus
options.description: Improve treatment capacity and physician availability, but labor conditions improve more slowly.

options.label: Balanced
options.description: Maintain a balanced health and welfare strategy.

options.label: Care and Labor
options.description: Expand elder care and labor protections, improving family resilience and workplace balance.

regionalTarget.name: Rural Clinic Support
regionalTarget.description: Direct physicians, clinics, and care support into one underserved region.

emergency.name: Emergency Care Surge
emergency.description: Launch a rapid health workforce deployment to a strained region.

education_minister.department: Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology

tierSetting.name: Curriculum Focus
tierSetting.description: Choose whether to emphasize exam performance, balanced learning, or creativity and student wellbeing.

options.label: Exam Focus
options.description: Push exam preparation harder for stronger test outcomes.

options.label: Balanced
options.description: Maintain the current balance between rigor and wellbeing.

options.label: Wellbeing Focus
options.description: Reduce pressure and widen broader skills development, with more gradual exam gains.

regionalTarget.name: School Modernization Priority
regionalTarget.description: Target one region for school modernization and teacher support.

emergency.name: Teacher Retention Surge
emergency.description: Deploy emergency staffing support and retention grants to one region's school system.

land_minister.department: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism

tierSetting.name: Infrastructure Priority
tierSetting.description: Choose whether MLIT prioritizes mobility, resilience, or a balanced rollout.

options.label: Mobility
options.description: Push rail, roads, and logistics throughput first.

options.label: Balanced
options.description: Maintain a balanced infrastructure program.

options.label: Resilience
options.description: Prioritize flood, quake, and evacuation resilience projects.

regionalTarget.name: Infrastructure Investment Priority
regionalTarget.description: Concentrate major transport and resilience investment into one region.

emergency.name: Emergency Infrastructure Mobilization
emergency.description: Deploy urgent repair and logistics crews to one region after a disruption.

tierSetting.name: Energy Transition Stance
tierSetting.description: Choose whether the ministry leans harder into renewables, a balanced transition, or reliability-first regulation.

options.label: Reliability First
options.description: Focus on system stability and tighter nuclear oversight before accelerating green rollout.

options.label: Balanced
options.description: Maintain a balanced transition path.

options.label: Green Push

regionalTarget.name: Clean Industry Zone
regionalTarget.description: Designate one region for concentrated decarbonization and environmental remediation.

emergency.name: Air Quality Intervention
emergency.description: Deploy emergency emissions restrictions and monitoring in one region with severe air-quality problems.

internal_affairs_minister.department: Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications

allocation.name: Regional Funding Allocation
allocation.description: Allocate the national transfer pool across all eight Japanese regions. The total allocation must sum to 100%.

tierSetting.name: Local Governance Focus

options.label: Digital First
options.description: Prioritize digital services and municipal connectivity.

options.label: Balanced
options.description: Maintain a balanced local-governance strategy.

options.label: Regional Revitalization
options.description: Prioritize shrinking-region support and local civic participation.

regionalTarget.name: Regional Revitalization Priority
regionalTarget.description: Concentrate local-government support, communications funding, and revitalization effort in one region.

emergency.name: Municipal Resilience Support
emergency.description: Deploy an emergency package of communications and local-administration support to one region.

value.description: The Prime Minister appoints ministers to the Cabinet of Japan without a separate Diet confirmation vote. Key roles include the Chief Cabinet Secretary, the Ministers of Finance and Justice, and the ministers responsible for foreign affairs, defense, the economy, and local administration. Ministers serve at the PM's pleasure and can be dismissed at any time, but each post can only be filled once every 24 turns.

hero.tagline: Kantei · Ministers appointed directly by the Prime Minister
